# invariant factors　`def.invariant-factor`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.invariant-factor)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.invariant-factor.md)

The nonzero elements $d_i$ (unique up to units; for $R = K[x]$ one takes the monic representative) are the **invariant factors** of $A$. Equivalently, $d_1 \cdots d_k$ is the greatest common divisor of all minors of $A$ of size $k$.

In particular, for $A \in M_n(K)$, the nonconstant invariant factors of $xI - A \in M_n(K[x])$ are called the **invariant factors** of the linear operator $A$.
